navigation_header.description: Fixed top HUD header with glassmorphism backdrop, live season badge, active match counter, player user menu, and primary section tabs
features: Navigation Tabs (Dashboard, Matches, Log Match, Leaderboard, Matrix, Matchmaking, Seasons)

dashboard.description: Esports Command Center displaying overall telemetry, winrates by role, champion spotlight, season countdown, and recent match feed

match_log_form.description: Tactical match recorder supporting 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 formats. Dynamic team slot generation with preloaded Battlerite champion roster categorized by Melee, Ranged, and Support roles, round selector, season picker, and ELO differential calculator preview

matches_history.description: Filterable history feed with search, season filter, player filter, role filter, expanded round breakdown details, and win/loss badges

leaderboard.description: Ranked ELO ladder with season filter, tier badges (Grandmaster, Champion, Diamond, Gold, Silver), round-differential stats, peak ELO, and winrate trends

player_profile.description: Comprehensive individual player dossier featuring winrate radar, most played champion badges, role distribution, head-to-head records against rival players, and recent match logs

pvp_matrix.description: Interactive Player-vs-Player winrate matrix table showing match records, win percentages, and round differentials when paired together or playing against each other

matchmaking_tool.description: Algorithmic team balancer where users select a pool of available players, toggle balance modes (MMR Only, Role Synergy Only, or Hybrid Balanced), and receive mathematically optimal 2v2 or 3v3 matchups with estimated win probabilities

season_management.description: Admin console to create new competitive seasons, archive/close active seasons, view historical season summary stats, and set active season defaults

auth_login.description: Tactical authentication terminal with JWT login/logout, sample preset credentials quick-fill for fast testing

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project React setup.
Implement high-contrast dark cockpit aesthetics using specified hex codes (#06080E bg, #0C101B card, #00F0FF cyan accents, #FFB800 amber accents).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, select dropdowns, form fields, table rows) have explicit data-testid attributes.

Preload full Battlerite Champions roster with roles: Melee (Bakko, Croak, Freya, Jamila, Raigon, Rook, Shifu, Thorn), Ranged (Alysia, Destiny, Ezmo, Iva, Jade, Jumong, Shen Rao, Taya), Support (Blossom, Lucie, Pearl, Pestilus, Poloma, Sirius, Zander).
Standard ELO calculation formula must use K=32 with round-differential multiplier: Delta = K * (ActualScore - ExpectedScore) * (1 + (RoundDiff / MaxRounds)).
Matchmaking balance tool must implement 3 mode options: MMR Balance, Role Synergy Balance, or Combined Hybrid Balance, providing clear team allocations with synergy scores.
Player-vs-Player winrate matrix must render interactive head-to-head cells showing wins/losses and win rate percentages with color coding.
Include pre-seeded realistic mock data (at least 15+ matches across 2 seasons with 8+ players) so all statistics, leaderboards, profiles, and matrix tools display populated telemetry out of the box.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for tactical HUD icon visuals (Swords, Shield, Crosshair, Trophy, Flame, Users, Activity, Sliders, Zap, Award).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use pure transparent backgrounds on navigation bars or dropdown menus; use rgba dark backdrop with blur.
Add transition effects to buttons and hover states, avoiding 'transition: all' to preserve CSS transform stability.
Maintain high APCA text contrast: bright white or neon cyan headers against obsidian dark backgrounds.
Ensure generous internal container padding (p-4 to p-8) to prevent text colliding with container borders.
All key user interactions must trigger immediate UI feedback or toast notifications (using sonner).
